author: daniellehrner

author: yorickdowne
content:
The threat may be quite fuzzy by its nature. How worried should one be about ECDSA being broken by AI? If it happens, I expect it'll be a binary event. Today it's fine, tomorrow it's broken. Does it matter to get to PQ (which is also PAI) by late 2027, or is it OK to take a bit longer to late 2028?

I don't have the answer to this. Models are opaque, and model capabilities evolve rapidly in some areas and slowly in others.

From my perspective, I'd like to see trade-offs discussed. Is Gasper+PQ actually faster to do than  DC+PQ? If so, by how much? How does it impact the decentralized long tail of validators, that is home stakers? Those are, by Ben's survey, one of the key differentiators of Ethereum. Does Gasper+PQ make DC+PQ later harder?

author: yorickdowne
content:
From the outside looking in, the answer to some of those isn't known yet. For example, if it turns out "gossipsub is fine in DC but not in Gasper" (unknown currently if I read the blog right), then Gasper+PQ is now Gasper+new-p2p-protocol+PQ, and at that point DC+PQ may be the better path.

Discovery to be done.

author: potuz
content:
> Does Gasper+PQ make DC+PQ later harder? 
I can only reply to this one and, if Gasper is viable (which is not entirely clear to me but looks like it) then no, Gasper + PQ makes DC + PQ simpler as all PQ changes are necessary for DC, and shipping DC + PQ at once seems to be a much larger harder to test and coordinate fork.

author: potuz
content: I really wish people forget about the AI angle, I really think it is a mistake to feed on this. However, if we don't take PQ seriously we'll keep piling up features that are obviously incompatible with it.

author: benjaminion
content:
Indeed. Just to reiterate, no governance decisions were made at Devcon, and the only venue remains ACD.

That said, I am not anticipating this Thursday's ACDC being a decision-making call. I'll create the agenda in due course, but I want to give space to air all of these issues, and to get everybody up to speed. I'd rather make stronger decisions in two weeks than hasty decisions this time.

I envisage first a recap from Will on the L1 R&D days and some context for why we are considering re-planning. Then going through some open questions to try to discern some collective views:
1. What level of urgency should we have around the PQ threat (or P-AI if you like)?
2. In view of 1, what range of viable options do we have?
3. In view of 2, what information do we need in order to make sound decisions?

I am hoping that a couple of experts in PQ timelines and ECC will be available for q&a on the call to help us make up our own minds on the urgency level.
